stock_uncle_insight.date_header: 9/23 法人與主力大戶主要買超股票

buyer_groups.group_title: 1. 外資大戶：狂掃面板雙虎與半導體低基期股

stocks.description: 肖年仔，你看外資這波狂掃友達，一口氣買超 24.5 萬張，這不是玩假的，擺明了就是看好面板產業谷底翻身，準備要鎖碼了啦！
聯電這檔成熟製程的，外資也買了 5.05 萬張，投信跟自營商也跟著買，這就是法人有共識，覺得半導體修正夠了，低基期開始卡位了啦！
面板雙虎的另一隻，群創也被外資敲進 2.48 萬張，跟友達一樣，外資大戶在賭產業復甦，韭菜們別傻傻地去追高AI，這種低基期才是真香。
這檔半導體封測的，外資買超 1.61 萬張，投信也買了近 3 千張，看來法人對半導體下游的看法也轉趨樂觀，準備要點火了。

buyer_groups.group_title: 2. 投信大戶（本土國家隊）：航空避險與半導體共識

stocks.description: 投信也跟著外資買聯電，敲進 7857 張，這表示本土國家隊也認同聯電的價值，不是黑白買的，是看好後市的共識單。
肖年仔，你看投信買超華航 5133 張，長榮航也買了 3993 張，這擺明了就是高檔避險，把資金從高風險股撤出來，轉進這種有旺季效應的傳產股，國際航空業有復甦跡象，他們在卡位啦！
跟華航一樣，投信買超長榮航 3993 張，航空雙雄一起買，這不是巧合，是法人在找資金避風港，順便搭上國際航空業復甦的順風車。
連元大高股息這種ETF都買了 2450 張，這很明顯就是投信在避險，大盤震盪，資金先躲到高殖利率的ETF裡面，求個安穩啦！

buyer_groups.group_title: 3. 內資主力與實戶：跟單面板與半導體，小心隔日沖

stocks.description: 自營商也跟著外資買友達，敲進 1816 張，雖然量不大，但方向一致，顯示內資也看到面板的機會，但肖年仔要小心，自營商的單很多都是避險或短線，別傻傻追高被倒貨。
南茂這檔封測股，自營商買超 1253 張，跟著外資買半導體下游，這波半導體修正後，很多低基期的都被盯上了。
自營商也買聯電 960 張，三大法人都有買，這檔聯電看來是法人共識股，但自營商的量小，可能只是避險盤或短線操作，別太樂觀。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略一：低基期產業復甦卡位戰（面板、半導體成熟製程）
strategies.strategy_content: 肖年仔，你看外資大戶狂掃友達、群創這種面板雙虎，還有聯電、京元電這種半導體成熟製程的股票，這擺明了就是看準這些產業已經跌無可跌，準備要谷底翻身了。國際油價雖然今天有跌，但柴油短缺問題還會持續到 2027 年，這代表全球經濟還是有不確定性，資金會往這種低基期、有復甦題材的板塊移動，先卡位等風來，這才是聰明錢的玩法。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略二：高檔AI股獲利了結，資金轉進避險與傳產
strategies.strategy_content: 緯創這檔AI概念股，外資跟投信同步大賣，外資倒了 3.05 萬張，投信也賣了 5434 張，這很明顯就是高檔獲利了結，把錢從AI股撤出來。這些錢不是憑空消失，一部分就轉進了像華航、長榮航這種有旺季效應的航空股，投信買超航空雙雄，加上國際新聞說有大銀行看好航空巨頭，這就是資金在找避風港，順便搭上產業復甦的便車。另一部分則流向元大高股息這種ETF，求個穩字訣。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略三：法人共識下的半導體下游布局
strategies.strategy_content: 聯電、京元電子這兩檔，外資、投信、自營商都有買超，這代表法人對半導體下游或成熟製程的看法有高度共識。在整體半導體景氣還不明朗的時候，這些相對穩健、評價面較低的標的，就成了法人資金的優先選擇。他們不是在追高，而是在修正後找尋價值，準備下一波的行情。

stock_uncle_insight.summary: 肖年仔，今天大戶們的動作很清楚，高檔AI股在倒貨，資金轉往低基期的面板、半導體成熟製程，還有航空這種有避險跟旺季題材的傳產股。別傻傻地追高，學著看懂主力在玩什麼把戲，才能在市場上活得久！

top_brokerages_analysis.uncle_logic: 美商高盛這種外資大戶，一次買超友達 8.58 萬張，這不是隔日沖，這擺明了就是看好面板產業的波段行情，準備要鎖碼了，真金白銀在卡位，肖年仔可以多留意。
凱基台北這種短線分點也買友達 726 張，雖然量不大，但跟著外資大戶的方向走，很可能就是看到外資在買，想跟風賺個短線價差。肖年仔要小心，這種分點隔日沖的機率很高，別傻傻地去接刀。
元大投信買超聯電 3536 張，這就是本土國家隊的動作，跟外資有共識，看好聯電的低基期價值。投信的單通常比較有波段性，不是玩短線的。
摩根大通這種外資大戶，一口氣賣超緯創 9164 張，這跟外資法人賣超緯創的趨勢一致，很明顯就是AI概念股高檔獲利了結，準備把錢轉到其他地方去。韭菜們，別再傻傻地去接這種倒貨的單了！

english_professor_news.title: Bank of America says buy tumbling shares of aviation giant

level1_blind.text:
Boeing (BA) shares fell again this week. The stock closed at $198.20 on Friday, September 18, down 4.83% over the past five trading days and 12.98% year to date.

The drop came after comments from CEO Kelly Ortberg at Morgan Stanley's Laguna Conference on September 16, where he identified new challenges on the 737 and 787 production ramps, and pushed 777X certification testing further into 2027.

Boeing is already under pressure to prove that its turnaround is feasible, and the CEO's comments only added to investors' caution. Yet, even with the caution, at least one major bank sees the pullback as a chance to add shares of the plane maker at a discount.

Ortberg told the audience at the Morgan Stanley conference that the 737 production line has not yet stabilized at the 47-jets-per-month rate Boeing had targeted. The delay is due to in-house production of wings, though Boeing said the broader supply chain is holding up.

On a more positive note, Ortberg said the 737 MAX 10 variant should get its certification "very soon," and told analysts, "When I left Seattle yesterday, I think we had three deliverables to complete."

Ortberg also confirmed that certification testing on the 777X, Boeing's delayed widebody, would extend into 2027. The plane is already about seven years past its original schedule, and its ETOPS certification has been held up by an engine seal issue on the GE Aerospace-built GE9X turbine.

GE Aerospace (GE) responded that certification can move forward with the existing seals, and said the upgraded parts began shipping in August. Boeing designs and builds commercial jets, defense aircraft and space systems, so any issue in the production ramp affects revenue and the delivery schedules airlines have already committed to.

Bank of America aerospace analyst Ronald Epstein used the selloff to reiterate his Buy rating and $270 price target. Epstein has covered aerospace and defense at Bank of America for over a decade and holds a five-star analyst rating from TipRanks, which makes his call credible with institutional investors.

level2_keywords.meaning: 產能爬坡，指新產品或新產線從低產量逐步提升至目標產量的過程。

english_professor_news.title: Global diesel shortage from Iran, Ukraine wars to last into 2027

level1_blind.text:
With U.S. retail diesel prices topping $6 a gallon this month for the first time, a worldwide shortage fueled by conflicts in Iran and Ukraine shows little sign of easing before next year, according to Reuters.

U.S. diesel stockpiles stood at 107.9 million barrels as of September 11 — a figure that, for that point in the calendar year, has not been matched since the EIA began keeping records in 1982. According to the EIA's own public projections, distillate fuel oil stocks — a category that includes diesel — are set to drop under 100 million barrels in September and stay beneath the five-year low through all of 2026 and into most of 2027. The agency projects U.S. retail diesel prices will average $5.55 a gallon in the fourth quarter of 2026 and $4.40 a gallon in 2027.

Storage market data reinforces that outlook. October bookings for leasable diesel storage across North America and the Caribbean Islands reached 13 million barrels — a four-year peak — compared with just 11 million barrels available back in June, Steven Barsamian, chief operating officer of storage broker The Tank Tiger, told Reuters. Barsamian said that leases are going unsigned because there is little diesel available to store, adding that falling inventories alongside rising tank availability together suggest traders anticipate supplies will stay tight well into at least early next year.

The shortage stems from supply disruptions on two fronts. Conflict in the Middle East has restricted tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, cutting crude flows and constraining refinery output, while Ukrainian strikes on Russian refining infrastructure have compounded those losses. The EIA said it estimates refinery outages in Russia will continue to affect the global distillate market through the first half of 2027.

European and Asian inventories are also strained. At the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp hub, July inventory levels sat roughly 16% under the five-year average, Insights Global data showed, according to Reuters. Singapore's distillate holdings have lately run around 8.2 million barrels on average, trailing the 9.6 million-barrel pace recorded through 2025.

As detailed in earlier coverage, the price surge is rippling through freight, agriculture, and home heating. Carmit Glik, CEO of Ship4wd, said diesel costs move through "freight rates, farm equipment, food delivery, and home heating — anything that touches a truck at some point in its journey," according to Reuters. Mark Wolfe, executive director of the National Energy Assistance Directors Association, warned that households dependent on heating oil — concentrated in the Northeast — could face bills as much as 31% higher this winter if diesel prices hold at current levels.

Some relief could emerge. The EIA's September Short-Term Energy Outlook expects most Middle East crude production to return to near pre-conflict averages by the second quarter of 2027, which the agency said would boost refinery output and allow distillate inventories to rebuild. Analysts also expect record diesel refining margins to encourage more production.

Nevertheless, a flare-up in either the Middle East or the Russia-Ukraine war, or an unexpected refinery disruption, could send prices sharply higher again. Alex Hodes, director of energy market strategy at StoneX, put it plainly to Reuters: "Current fundamentals point to higher prices staying here for a while."

english_professor_news.level2_context: 各位同學，這篇新聞在探討全球柴油供應短缺的嚴峻情勢，並預測這種緊張狀況可能持續到 2027 年。其核心背景脈絡在於地緣政治衝突，特別是中東地區的戰事限制了油輪通過荷莫茲海峽，導致原油供應受阻，進而影響煉油廠的產能。同時，烏克蘭對俄羅斯煉油設施的襲擊，也大幅減少了全球柴油的供應量。這種供應鏈的衝擊，使得美國柴油庫存創下歷史新低，價格飆升。這不僅影響了貨運、農業等產業的營運成本，也直接衝擊到家庭取暖的開銷。儘管有預期中東原油產量可能在未來幾年恢復，且高煉油利潤可能刺激增產，但任何新的衝突或煉油廠意外，都可能再次推高價格，顯示能源市場的脆弱性與地緣政治的高度相關性。

level3_translation.sentence: Storage market data reinforces that outlook.
level3_translation.translation: 儲存市場數據也印證了這一預期。

level3_translation.sentence: October bookings for leasable diesel storage across North America and the Caribbean Islands reached 13 million barrels — a four-year peak — compared with just 11 million barrels available back in June, Steven Barsamian, chief operating officer of storage broker The Tank Tiger, told Reuters.
level3_translation.translation: 儲存經紀公司 The Tank Tiger 的營運長 Steven Barsamian 告訴路透社，北美和加勒比海地區可租賃柴油儲存空間的 10 月預訂量達到 1,300 萬桶，創下四年新高，而 6 月時僅有 1,100 萬桶可用。

level3_translation.sentence: Barsamian said that leases are going unsigned because there is little diesel available to store, adding that falling inventories alongside rising tank availability together suggest traders anticipate supplies will stay tight well into at least early next year.
level3_translation.translation: Barsamian 表示，許多租賃合約未能簽署，是因為幾乎沒有柴油可供儲存；他補充說，庫存下降但儲存槽可用性上升的現象，共同暗示交易商預期供應緊張狀況將至少持續到明年年初。

level3_translation.sentence: The shortage stems from supply disruptions on two fronts.
level3_translation.translation: 這波短缺源於兩個方面的供應中斷。

level3_translation.sentence: Conflict in the Middle East has restricted tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, cutting crude flows and constraining refinery output, while Ukrainian strikes on Russian refining infrastructure have compounded those losses.
level3_translation.translation: 中東地區的衝突限制了油輪通過荷莫茲海峽的交通，減少了原油流量並抑制了煉油廠產量；同時，烏克蘭對俄羅斯煉油基礎設施的襲擊，也加劇了這些損失。

level3_translation.sentence: The EIA said it estimates refinery outages in Russia will continue to affect the global distillate market through the first half of 2027.
level3_translation.translation: EIA 表示，預計俄羅斯的煉油廠停工將持續影響全球餾分油市場，直到 2027 年上半年。

level3_translation.sentence: European and Asian inventories are also strained.
level3_translation.translation: 歐洲和亞洲的庫存也同樣吃緊。

level3_translation.sentence: At the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp hub, July inventory levels sat roughly 16% under the five-year average, Insights Global data showed, according to Reuters.
level3_translation.translation: 路透社引述 Insights Global 的數據顯示，在阿姆斯特丹-鹿特丹-安特衛普（ARA）樞紐，7 月的庫存水平比五年平均值低了約 16%。

level3_translation.sentence: Singapore's distillate holdings have lately run around 8.2 million barrels on average, trailing the 9.6 million-barrel pace recorded through 2025.
level3_translation.translation: 新加坡的餾分油庫存近期平均約為 820 萬桶，落後於 2025 年記錄的 960 萬桶平均水平。

level3_translation.sentence: As detailed in earlier coverage, the price surge is rippling through freight, agriculture, and home heating.
level3_translation.translation: 正如先前報導所詳述，柴油價格飆升正對貨運、農業和家庭取暖產生連鎖反應。

level3_translation.sentence: Carmit Glik, CEO of Ship4wd, said diesel costs move through "freight rates, farm equipment, food delivery, and home heating — anything that touches a truck at some point in its journey," according to Reuters.
level3_translation.translation: 路透社報導，Ship4wd 執行長 Carmit Glik 表示，柴油成本會透過『貨運費率、農用設備、食品配送和家庭取暖——任何在運輸過程中會接觸到卡車的事物』來傳導。

level3_translation.sentence: Mark Wolfe, executive director of the National Energy Assistance Directors Association, warned that households dependent on heating oil — concentrated in the Northeast — could face bills as much as 31% higher this winter if diesel prices hold at current levels.
level3_translation.translation: 全國能源援助主任協會執行董事 Mark Wolfe 警告，如果柴油價格維持在目前水平，東北部地區依賴取暖用油的家庭，今年冬天可能面臨高達 31% 的帳單漲幅。

level3_translation.sentence: Some relief could emerge.
level3_translation.translation: 不過，一些緩解的跡象可能會出現。

level3_translation.sentence: The EIA's September Short-Term Energy Outlook expects most Middle East crude production to return to near pre-conflict averages by the second quarter of 2027, which the agency said would boost refinery output and allow distillate inventories to rebuild.
level3_translation.translation: EIA 的 9 月短期能源展望預計，大部分中東原油產量將在 2027 年第二季前恢復到接近衝突前的平均水平，該機構表示這將提振煉油廠產量並讓餾分油庫存得以重建。

level3_translation.sentence: Analysts also expect record diesel refining margins to encourage more production.
level3_translation.translation: 分析師也預期，創紀錄的柴油煉油利潤將鼓勵更多產量。

level3_translation.sentence: Nevertheless, a flare-up in either the Middle East or the Russia-Ukraine war, or an unexpected refinery disruption, could send prices sharply higher again.
level3_translation.translation: 然而，無論是中東或俄烏戰爭的衝突升級，或是意外的煉油廠中斷，都可能再次導致價格急劇上漲。

level3_translation.sentence: Alex Hodes, director of energy market strategy at StoneX, put it plainly to Reuters: "Current fundamentals point to higher prices staying here for a while."
level3_translation.translation: StoneX 能源市場策略總監 Alex Hodes 向路透社直言：『目前的市場基本面顯示，高油價將會持續一段時間。』

english_professor_news.title: Crude Prices Sink on Larger Flows of Oil Through the Strait of Hormuz
english_professor_news.level1_blind:
October WTI crude oil (CLV26) is down -4.78 (-4.77%) today, and October RBOB gasoline (RBV26) is down -0.0319 (-0.90%).

Crude oil and gasoline prices are sharply lower today, with crude dropping to a 1.5-week low. Crude prices are retreating in hopes that diplomacy will end hostilities in the Middle East and that an increase in crude flows moving through the Strait of Hormuz will ease supply concerns.

Crude oil prices are falling today on diplomatic efforts to end the US-Iran war and signs that crude flows are still getting through the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump said he would "probably" be open to meeting Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York this week.

Also, more crude supplies are moving through the Strait of Hormuz, easing supply concerns, after Admiral Brad Cooper, head of US Central Command, said crude and liquefied natural gas flows through the Strait of Hormuz over the past two weeks are running at a six-month high.

Losses in crude oil accelerated today after data from the European Union's Sentinel 2 satellite showed oil supertankers with the capacity to collect 14 million bbl of oil were observed at Saudi Arabia's export installations inside the Persian Gulf, signaling the country has shifted its crude exports back toward the Strait of Hormuz following the shutdown of its East-West pipeline.

Crude oil prices rallied to a 4-month high last Tuesday on fears that global oil supplies will tighten further after Saudi Arabia shut down its key East-West pipeline, disrupting a key route that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz. The 750-mile-long East-West pipeline, which carries 7 million bpd of crude, was closed as a precaution following attacks by Houthi rebels. The pipeline moves oil away from the Persian Gulf toward the Red Sea, where it can be loaded on tankers. Last Tuesday, Saudi Aramco said it is delaying oil deliveries to some European customers because of the pipeline closure.

Crude also has support as Yemen's Houthi rebels target energy facilities in Saudi Arabia, forcing several oil facilities to halt production. Saudi Arabia said that its crude production in August fell to 6.238 million bpd, the lowest since 1990.

The advances by the Houthi rebels to take territory along the Red Sea in Yemen are also contributing to concerns about tighter oil supplies from the Middle East. Last Tuesday, the Houthis captured a pair of islands near the Bab-al-Mandeb Strait. That followed their seizure of Perim Island and the Red Sea port city of Mokha at the southern end of the Red Sea, putting the group in a stronger position to attack ships. Since the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, Saudi Arabia had pivoted to the Red Sea to export most of its oil over the past two months. However, escalating tensions with the Houthis have disrupted that route.

market_linker_insight.market_connection: 兩個 news 的內容看似相互無關，但透過分析 diesel shortage 的原因和 crude prices 的變化，發現 diesel shortage 的持續時間可能會延長至 2027，從而對 crude prices 的變化產生影響。 diesel shortage 的持續時間會影響 crude prices 的變化，從而對全球能源市場產生影響。因此，需要密切關注 diesel shortage 的持續時間和 crude prices 的變化，來預測能源市場的趨勢。
